sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Two more ⚠️ WARNING checks on a release tracklist, from the track's own data and with no requests: a title that names a remixer ("Everlasting (Psyche remix)") while the track credits no remixer, and a medley title ("A / B") whose recording links works for fewer of its parts. Anonymous mixes ("(Extended Mix)", "(mono mix)", "(5.1 mix)", "(U.S. remix)") and non-musical parts in square brackets ("[band intro]") are not counted; the cell's tooltip names the remixer or the counts. The remix rules come from majkinetor's Credit Hoarder. Each tint has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The release tracklist's "Recording of work" column showed only the first work of a recording that links several; it now lists every work, one line each (with ▶ to fold a long list), each with its own "(live)"/"(cover)". The songs a medley work is made of stay in its "Work medley of" column.
